g.text: Before starting, read the 0–2 anchors for each indicator and note
that a higher score means better conditions.
Observe all three indicators from the same spot for the full 10
Record each component score, add them to give a total out of 6,
and write notes on anything unusual.
Positive descriptions are always on the left.
Site total = sum of the five row scores (−10 to +10).
All five sites surveyed 10:00–10:30 on the same weekday.
Paired-site record: managed site M and reference site R
Litter pieces counted in matched 10-minute periods
Visitors counted in the same periods
